title: Alice shields 25,000 mUSDC
summary: Alice deposits into the shielded pool. The deposit mints the compliance note her epoch chain starts from, and the amount is above the single-transaction threshold, so the pool emits a public size flag.
simplifications: One operator account deploys the contracts, attests the cohort, curates the blocklist, funds the deposits and relays every pool call. The spec gives these roles to separate parties.
The pool holds only this run's notes, so its anonymity set is far smaller than a busy pool's.
The audit committee is a single key (t = n = 1).
The wallet simulates each pool call and does not broadcast one that the pool refuses.
The chain is a local Anvil node.

title: Operator attests a cohort of 10 keys, Alice and Bob among them

plain.title: Alice and Bob pass the eligibility checks
plain.body: The operator checks account holders off-chain, then approves 10 keys in one batch, so no one can tell which approval belongs to whom. They can now use the pool; nobody has deposited yet.

plain.body: The operator issues the test stablecoin so the account holders have something to deposit. In production this money already exists.

plain.title: Alice moves dollars into the shielded pool
plain.body: The dollars leave Alice's public account for the shielded pool. The deposit is public; what Alice does with the money afterwards is not.

sees.public: The public sees that Alice deposited, and how much, but not where the money goes next.
